title: Graded Betti numbers of the Jacobian algebra of surfaces in $\mathbb P^3$
summary: We compute an explicit closed formula for the Hilbert polynomial of the Jacobian algebra $M(f)$ of a reduced surface $X:f=0$ in $\mathbb P^3$ in terms of the graded Betti numbers of the algebra $M(f)$. When $X$ has only isolated singularities, two results by A. du Plessis and C. T. C. Wall yield new necessary conditions for a set of positive integers to be the graded Betti numbers of the Jacobian algebra of such a surface.
